User Guides

Task-oriented guides for using Powerful.jl effectively.

Getting Started

New to Powerful.jl? Start here:

  • Getting Started - Understanding the basic workflow and key concepts
  • Power Flow Analysis - Formulations, algorithms, and advanced options
  • Time-Domain Simulation - Dynamic simulation and transient analysis
  • Accessing Results - Working with solution variables

Additional Topics

  • Configuration - System, model, and solver settings via TOML or code
  • Report Customization - Controlling what appears in output reports

Learning Path

  1. Beginners: Read Getting Started to understand SystemModel, problems, and solutions
  2. Intermediate: Study Power Flow Analysis to learn about formulations and algorithms
  3. Advanced: Learn Time-Domain Simulation for dynamic analysis
  4. Practice: Work through the notebooks with hands-on examples
  5. Reference: Use the API Reference for complete function documentation

Note: These guides focus on how to accomplish tasks. For complete API details, see the API Reference. For implementation details, see the Design Documentation.
